chunks: The path of God, to whom belongs what is in the heavens and what is in the earth. Indeed, to God all matters return.

key_terms.صِرَاطِ اللَّهِ: The path or way of God

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that all matters return to God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Tawhid al-Mulk* (Divine Sovereignty), affirming that all authority and creation belong exclusively to Allah, who is the ultimate source of all affairs. It serves as a theological anchor for believers, reminding them that while human affairs may seem complex, their final resolution and judgment rest solely with the Divine. This reinforces the Shia emphasis on returning to God as the ultimate reference in both spiritual and worldly matters.
